app.name: Tadween
app.tagline: Write in any language. Keep it to yourself.

common.crashTitle: Something went wrong on this screen.
common.crashBody: Your saved pages are safe. Reload to carry on.

welcome.body: A quiet place to write, in Arabic, French or English. Everything stays on this computer, encrypted.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: This sets the language of the interface. You can write in any language, whatever you choose here.

appearance.title: Choose a look
appearance.body: White paper for bright rooms, warm paper, or ink at night. Or let Windows switch between light and night.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.localBody: No account, no cloud, no tracking. Tadween never connects to the internet.
privacy.encryptedBody: Every page, title and folder is encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 before it touches the disk.
privacy.keyBody: The key comes from your password through Argon2id. It lives in memory and is wiped when you lock.

password.title: Create your account
password.body: Your username and password unlock your notes. Only this computer knows them.
password.label: Password
password.ruleVariety: Two kinds of characters (letters, numbers, symbols), or 12+ characters
password.taken: This username already exists on this computer.

recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.body: If you forget your password, this key is the only way back in. Nobody can reset it for you, not even Tadween.
recovery.confirm: I saved my recovery key somewhere safe
recovery.hint: Write it on paper or keep it in a password manager.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.body: This is how Tadween will greet you. You can change it any time in Settings.

hello.title: Hello
hello.body: Meet the crew. Your notebook is ready.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to open your notes.
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {{s}} s.
login.recoverySubtitle: Enter your username and the key you saved, then choose a new password.
login.wrongKey: That recovery key is not right.
login.unreadable_one: {{count}} page could not be decrypted and was skipped.
login.unreadable_other: {{count}} pages could not be decrypted and were skipped.
login.playHint: Drag the dot. Click the others.

sidebar.deleteFolder: Delete “{{name}}”? Its pages stay, without a folder.

page.deleteConfirm: Delete this page forever? This cannot be undone.
page.inTrash: This page is in the trash.
page.cannotNest: A page can't go inside itself.
page.saveFailed: This page could not be saved. Your text is still here; keep the page open and try again.
page.tooLarge: This page is too large to save. Remove an image or move part of it to another page.

trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} page forever? This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} pages forever? This cannot be undone.

settings.backdropHint: Shown behind the cast while Tadween is locked. Each one is drawn for Day, Light and Night.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Arabic turns the whole app right to left. Your writing always follows its own direction.
settings.storage: Your notes live in the app data folder, encrypted. Tadween has no network access.
settings.recoveryHint: Lost your recovery key? Create a new one. The old key stops working right away.
settings.yourNameHint: How Tadween greets you. Your username ({{username}}) stays the same.
settings.deleteAccountHint: Erases this account and everything in it from this computer: pages, files, folders and settings. Other accounts are not touched. Nobody can bring it back, so export what you want to keep first.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm: Delete the account “{{username}}” and all of its pages for good? This cannot be undone.

editor.add: Click to add a block below
editor.pdfMissing: This file could not be read.
editor.cannotTurn: That selection can't be turned into this block.
editor.chooseImageHint: Or paste one, or drop it onto the page.
editor.choosePdfHint: It is stored encrypted with the page.

home.title: Home

warm.morning: The notebook is open. Take your time.
warm.afternoon: Nothing is waiting for you here.
warm.night: The others are asleep. Nobody reads this but you.
warm.away: It's been a while. Everything is where you left it.

ask.morning: What's on your mind this morning?
ask.away: What happened while you were away?

cast.qalam: I'm Qalam. I write the first line if you can't.
cast.waraqa: I'm Waraqa. I keep every page you give me.
cast.hibr: I'm Hibr. Everything here stays between us.
cast.noon: I'm Noon. I hold the dot, and today's date.
cast.nuqta: I'm Nuqta. I lock the door when you leave.

home.pinHint: Pin a folder to keep it in the sidebar.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.writeFor: Write the journal for this day

transfer.exportBody: Every page as Markdown with its images and PDFs, plus a complete Tadween backup, in one zip file. The export is not encrypted: keep it somewhere safe.
transfer.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
transfer.importBody: Bring your notes from another app. Folders, dates, images and PDFs come along.
transfer.notionHint: Choose the exported .zip (Markdown or HTML). Databases come in as tables.
transfer.spreadsheetHint: .csv, .xlsx or .xls: each sheet becomes a page with a table
transfer.exportedMissing_one: {{count}} file could not be read and was left out.
transfer.exportedMissing_other: {{count}} files could not be read and were left out.

home.qalam: I write the first line. Press New page, or Ctrl N, and just start. Type / for headings, lists, tables, columns and more.
home.waraqa: All your pages live here, on a timeline with your folders beside it. Drag a page onto a folder to file it, or right-click it for more.
home.hibr: Lost something? Search with Ctrl K. I find any page, in Arabic or Latin, with or without diacritics.
home.noon: Keep a daily journal. Each day you write fills a dot on the Calendar. Try not to break the line.
home.nuqta: Everything stays on this computer, encrypted with your password. Press Lock, or Ctrl L, when you step away.

settings.waraqa: This is the name I greet you with. Change it whenever you like; your username stays the same.
settings.noon: Pick the language of the app. In Arabic the whole app turns right to left; your writing always follows its own direction.
settings.nuqta: Security lives here: when to lock, your password, and a new recovery key if you lose yours.
settings.hibr: Coming from Obsidian or Notion? Bring everything in here. You can export all your pages too.

page.qalam: Every page starts with a title. Press Enter to jump into the text.
page.hibr: Type / to add a heading, list, table, PDF, columns or a page inside this page. Select words to bold, link or highlight them. Hover a line and drag the handle to move it.
page.noon: Give the page a date, tick Daily journal to make it a diary entry, or file it in a folder.
page.nuqta: No save button: I save and encrypt every word as you type. Pin or move the page from up here.
page.waraqa: Prefer to speak? Press Dictate down here, choose the language you speak, and I write as you talk. Everything stays on this computer.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.noMicrophone: No microphone found. Plug one in or allow Tadween in Windows privacy settings.
dictation.noModel: The speech model is missing. Reinstall Tadween to restore it.
dictation.credits: Dictation runs on this computer: NVIDIA FastConformer Arabic and Canary 180m Flash (CC BY 4.0), Silero VAD (MIT) and sherpa-onnx (Apache 2.0). Your voice is never recorded or sent anywhere.
